description: Planning dental treatment in Turkey? Get indicative prices for premium dental implants (Nobel Biocare, Straumann), Ivoclar E.max veneers and crowns, zirconia crowns, Hollywood smile, and All-on-4/6/8 full-mouth implant packages, plus the clinic's written guarantee, the treating doctors' qualifications, visit logistics and aftercare, and a patient-review summary. The information comes from Taki Dent (takident.com), a dental clinic in Antalya, Turkey led by Dr Sadik Taki, a specialist prosthodontist, focused on implant, cosmetic and full-mouth restoration for international patients. Important: this is first-party, read-only data published by that ONE clinic - not a multi-clinic price comparison or a neutral directory. All prices are indicative 'from' figures, confirmed by the clinic after an assessment. If you want the clinic to contact you, an opt-in callback tool passes your name and phone or email to its patient-coordination team, only with your explicit consent, and it never collects medical details. Informational only: no medical advice, no diagnosis or treatment plan, and no payment.
